result.description:
MYAC Resources is currently seeking an experienced Truck Driver / Yard Person on behalf of our client, a well-established engineering and fabrication company based in Perth, Western Australia.
Our client is looking for a reliable and hands-on person for an immediate start. The successful candidate will take ownership of the yard while supporting the day-to-day operations of a busy fabrication workshop. This is a varied role involving truck driving, forklift operation, yard management and general trade-assistant duties.
About the role
As a Truck Driver/Yard Person you will support our workshop to ensure we deliver a quality product to our client, in full and on time.  
This will include:
Your responsibilities will include:
•	Providing support to the team as required to complete work activities
•	Performing daily pre-start checklist on vehicles to ensure they are fit for operations
•	Using the Forklift to move steel and equipment around the yard
•	Ensuring deliveries and collections are completed safely and on time
•	Loading and unloading trucks and delivery vehicles
•	Operating a variety of tools including grinders, power drills and other cutting or shaping tools as required to complete assigned tasks
•	Ability to take ownership of the Yard
About you
To be considered for this position, you must have:
•	A current and valid HR driver’s licence
•	A current forklift licence
•	Previous truck-driving experience
•	A positive, can-do attitude
•	A strong focus on safety and quality
•	The ability to work independently and as part of a team
•	The physical ability to undertake manual and hands-on work
•	Previous experience within an engineering, fabrication, mining or industrial workshop will be highly regarded.
What’s on offer
•	Full-time, ongoing employment
•	Competitive hourly rate based on experience
•	Immediate start available
•	A varied, hands-on position
•	A supportive and practical workshop team
•	Opportunity to grow with an established engineering and fabrication business
Apply Now
If you're an experienced Truck Driver / Yard Person looking for your next opportunity in Perth, we'd love to hear from you.
please submit your application using the apply now button or send your resume to ••••@myacresources.com.au
Apply today with your current resume and one of our recruitment specialists will be in touch

result.description:
Operating since 1982, Werner Engineering has an unparalleled reputation as the one stop engineering workshop of choice. They use the latest technology to offer fast, accurate and high quality workmanship to minimise down time and increase productivity and efficiency for their clients.

Werner Engineering is locally owned Mackay-based machining and fabrication workshop, specialising the manufacture and repair of parts for the mining, transport, sugar, agricultural and local industries

Werner Engineering is looking for FITTER/MACHINIST to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

To be considered for the role you will possess the following skills, experience, and attributes:
Trade qualified Fitter/Machinist
Forklift High Risk Ticket / Overhead crane / Dogging certificate highly regarded
Proven work experience in Fitting/Machining or similar role in the last 2 years
Previous experience in a workshop environment and understanding of Mining / Agricultural equipment and processes
Good technical background and ability to handle “one off’s” with attention to detail
Demonstrated experience in manual machining
A good working knowledge of drills, lathes and mills

Typical duties may include, but are not limited to: Fitter/Machinist

General machining including use of: Small Centre Lathes, Milling Machines, Radial Drills.
Keep abreast of technological changes
General fitting including the use of: Gear reduction Units of all size and type, Fluid Couplings and Power Transmission Devices, Boiler Feed Pumps and other Critical Process Pumps, Hydraulic Cylinders, Pump Impeller Rotating Assemblies, Conveying, Crushing and Stockpiling / Reclaiming Equipment, Large Components of Drag Lines and Mining Equipment and Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems
Application of fine tolerances to machined surfaces when fitting bearings, gearing, seals etc. to shafts and hubs with respect to heating/freezing techniques and the like
Sketch and accurately measure mechanical components from Gearboxes, Pumps and other Drive Equipment
Inspect, analyze and record critical mechanical information during the process of undertaking mechanical refurbishment work; this critical information would include the interpretations of wear and tear, mechanical damage to Gears, Shafts, Housing etc. recording of end floats, preloads, gear train, backlashes, tooth contacts and other at the start and completion of every refurbishment
Perform mechanical repairs, manufacture components and request equipment, materials and consumables as required within limits of authority
Understand specifications of the task at hand and the desired result by reading mechanical drawings

Personal attributes may include, but are not limited to:
Self-motivation and positive attitude.
Attention to detail and delivery of services to exceed client’s expectations.
Ability to Work Alone and In a Team environment
High level reasoning ability and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills
Flexible, adaptable, and resilient to stress.
Excellent math’s skills
Time management skills
Have a strong focus on workplace health & safety
Be familiar with general engineering and show ability to read and interpret job cards/drawings/materials
Able to pass a medical including drug & alcohol screening

If you possess the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature

Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent

Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

result.description:
Proudly established Family Business on the Gold Coast, Action Sheetmetal and Roofing’s history stretches back to the 1990’s. Through partnerships and our relationships, everything we do is to improve someone's quality of life - no matter how simply. We assist designers, architects, builders and engineers in the design and fabrication of their sheetmetal requirements. We specialise in stainless steel and aluminium products and also provide metal roofing and rainwater goods.

For more information about Action Sheetmetal and Roofing, and the services we provide, please visit our website at www.actionsheetmetal.com

We are seeking experienced DRAFTSPERSONS to join our busy workshop on a full time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Follow specifications and calculations to create various technical drawings
Prepare both rough sketches and detailed design work with CADD systems
Calculate dimensions, weight limitations and requirements in materials
Outline the construction process of the project on the technical drawings
Communicate with architects and engineers, and incorporating knowledge gained into drawings.
Prepare, review and redraft alongside the engineering team.
Ensure final designs are compliant with AS/NZ & ISO standards, including building regulations
Carry out design and development of products, including verification and validation of designs
Identify and communicate potential design problems to the rest of the team.
Keeping abreast of the latest developments and technologies in CADD systems/software.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
At least more than 4-years of experience in CADD
Profound knowledge in CAD software e.g AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong organisational and time management skills
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
